description: Clones a STATIC IMAGE ad into finished ads for your own product, into a reusable prompt TEMPLATE, or both — the template is what makes the ads and the ads are what prove the template. Round-trips the frame through gpt-image-2, nano-banana-pro or reve-2.1 until it reproduces, replaces every brand-specific with a {placeholder}, then fills it with your product pinned to a real photo. Use for "clone this ad for my product", "rebuild this competitor's ad for us", "make me ads like this", "reverse engineer this ad", "make this ad reusable", "add this to my prompt library", or "clone my competitors' ads" with NO file attached — it sources one via spy-competitor-ads rather than asking which. **Among cloners the source's medium decides**: a still, or nothing attached, lands here; "clone this ad" plus a VIDEO is clone-video-ad. NOT for generating an ad from a brief (chatgpt-image-ad, nano-banana-image-ad), nor animating a still as-is (image-to-motion). Refuses to render your product without a real photo of it.
